reports.description: I was contacted on Facebook by a lady to learn how to invest in Bitcoin, and she wanted me to reach out to her on Whatsapp. We talked once on the phone, but we mainly corresponded on Whatsapp. She wanted me to start with an initial investment of $1000 and later told me that it would be an additional $400 for me to use their investment platform for two months. So, the total investment was $1400. I purchased the Bitcoin and forwarded it to this Bitcoin address, so that it could be traded. The returns on the investment would then be forwarded to my Bitcoin wallet address, and the returns can be viewed in the account. I was told to set up an account on a website called fxlegalcoinstrade.com and to watch the investment for my returns. However, when it was time to withdraw the funds, I could not reach the person because she said that she would walk me through the process. I contacted customer service in their messenger app and received no response. I was told that no one was available and that they would contact me. I also called the number on the website, and the number is for a different company. Also, interestingly, the website greatly details their products, offerings, and testimonials, but there is no information as to how to retrieve ones profits. When I open the account, I see my assumed profits. However, Im curious to know if this Bitcoin wallet address is authentic. That is all I want to do for now is check the authenticity of the wallet address because this is where I sent my money to for trading. Thank you so much for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you soon. Have a wonderful day.
